diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly identified the baseline values from the draft (e.g., 12 workers, 100 queue threshold) without accessing any hidden information. While no checks leaked, the model's ability to perfectly match the draft's default state across all decisions suggests the decision space is too constrained by the public facts, making the hidden facts (PF1-PF4) trivial to avoid.
